case.summary: Monitoring flagged online transaction 3459158 ($149.92) on card C01104-K2 due to a high model score of 0.998. The transaction formed the culmination of a rapid 18-minute burst of four online purchases totaling $600.10 across four distinct billing regions, representing physically impossible geographic velocity. The activity was initiated via device D007387, which was flagged as new to this card account during the burst. Additionally, card C01104-K2 has six prior confirmed fraud cases, including case CC-5037 which involved an identical transaction pattern and device profile. The episode was determined to be card-not-present new-device fraud with a 0.97 probability, resulting in an immediate card block and case creation.
